text_hi: अस्पताल यहां से बहुत दूर है, सीधी बस नहीं चलती।
text_en: The hospital is very far from here; there is no direct bus.

text_hi: आने-जाने का किराया जुटाना मुश्किल है।
text_en: It is hard to arrange the fare for the journey there and back.

text_hi: गांव से जिला अस्पताल करीब 60 किमी, ऑटो वाले बहुत पैसा मांगते हैं
text_en: From the village the district hospital is about 60 km; auto drivers ask for a lot of money.
rationale: Long distance and high travel cost.

text_hi: बरसात में नदी की पुलिया डूब जाती है, अभी निकलना मुश्किल।
text_en: In the rains the culvert over the river gets submerged; hard to get out right now.
rationale: Route physically inaccessible; transport access barrier without any cost words.

text_hi: पिछले महीने का कर्ज अभी चुका नहीं पाए, जांच के लिए पैसे नहीं बचे।
text_en: They have not yet repaid last month's loan; no money is left for the tests.
rationale: Cannot afford cost of tests (out-of-pocket care cost).

text_hi: शहर के लिए सुबह एक ही जीप जाती है, वो छूट गई तो पूरा दिन खराब
text_en: Only one jeep goes to town in the morning; if she misses it the whole day is wasted.
rationale: Limited transport availability. No mention of her paid work, so not work_caregiving.

text_hi: उसके पास गाड़ी का कोई साधन नहीं है।
text_en: She has no means of transport.

text_hi: दवाई और जांच का खर्च सुनकर चुप हो गई, बोली इतना पैसा कहां से लाएं
text_en: She went quiet on hearing the cost of medicines and tests; said where would we get so much money.

text_hi: रास्ता कच्चा है, ट्रैक्टर के अलावा कुछ नहीं जाता।
text_en: The road is unpaved; nothing but tractors goes on it.
rationale: Poor road means no usable transport.

text_hi: बड़े अस्पताल तक दो बार बस बदलनी पड़ती है, खर्चा भी ज्यादा
text_en: She has to change buses twice to reach the big hospital, and the cost is also high.
rationale: Difficult journey and high travel cost.

text_hi: पैसे की तंगी है।
text_en: Money is tight.
rationale: General financial hardship stated; included in access_cost by definition.

text_hi: उधार लेकर ही जा पाएगी, अभी किसी से मिला नहीं
text_en: She can only go by borrowing money; she has not got it from anyone yet.

text_hi: रायपुर वाला अस्पताल बहुत दूर पड़ता है
text_en: The Raipur hospital is very far away.

text_hi: ज़मीन गिरवी है, घर में नकद बिल्कुल नहीं
text_en: The land is mortgaged; there is no cash at home at all.

text_hi: एम्बुलेंस के बारे में पूछा तो बोली वो सिर्फ इमरजेंसी में आती है, और कोई साधन नहीं
text_en: Asked about an ambulance, she said it only comes in emergencies, and there is no other transport.
rationale: No transport available. Her statement about ambulance use is not treated as a misunderstanding.

text_hi: ब्लॉक तक तो चली जाएगी, आगे जिला अस्पताल का किराया नहीं है।
text_en: She can manage to get to the block, but she does not have the fare onward to the district hospital.

text_hi: hospital bahut door hai, aane jaane ka kharcha nahi hai
text_en: The hospital is very far; there is no money for travel.

text_hi: gaon se shaher ke liye koi sadhan nahi milta
text_en: No transport is available from the village to town.

text_hi: paise ka intazaam nahi ho pa raha
text_en: Unable to arrange the money.

text_hi: 2 ghante paidal chalke road tak aana padta hai
text_en: She has to walk 2 hours to reach the road.

text_hi: transport ka problem hai, is route pe bus service band hai
text_en: There is a transport problem; the bus service on this route is stopped.

text_hi: fare afford nahi kar sakti, family already loan pe hai
text_en: She cannot afford the fare; the family is already in debt.

text_hi: पति ने कहा अभी अस्पताल जाने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
text_en: Her husband said there is no need to go to the hospital now.
rationale: Husband's decision blocks attendance. The view is his, not her own misunderstanding.

text_hi: सास की मर्ज़ी के बिना घर से बाहर नहीं जाती।
text_en: She does not leave the house without her mother-in-law's consent.

text_hi: साथ ले जाने वाला कोई नहीं है, अकेले कभी शहर नहीं गई।
text_en: There is no one to take her; she has never gone to town alone.
rationale: No family member available to accompany her.

text_hi: घरवाले कहते हैं पहले शादी का काम निपटा लो फिर देखेंगे
text_en: The family says finish the wedding work first and then they will see.

text_hi: बेटा बाहर कमाने गया है, वही ले जाता है, उसके लौटने तक रुकेगी
text_en: Her son has gone away to earn; he is the one who takes her, so she will wait until he returns.
rationale: Depends on a family member to accompany her. The work mentioned is the son's, not hers.

text_hi: ससुर जी नहीं मानते कि औरत की जांच बड़े अस्पताल में हो
text_en: Her father-in-law does not agree to a woman being examined at a big hospital.

text_hi: घर में बात करके बताएगी, अभी कुछ तय नहीं।
text_en: She will tell after discussing at home; nothing is decided yet.
rationale: Decision depends on the household. Borderline; a weaker signal than an explicit refusal.

text_hi: पति गुस्सैल हैं, उनसे पूछने की हिम्मत नहीं होती
text_en: Her husband is short-tempered; she does not dare ask him.
rationale: Cannot seek husband's permission. Her fear is of asking him, not of care, so fear_hesitancy is 0.

text_hi: जेठानी बोली ये सब बेकार के खर्चे हैं
text_en: Her elder sister-in-law said these are all useless expenses.
rationale: Family opposition. Mentions expenses but not inability to pay, so access_cost is 0.

text_hi: घर के मर्द खेत से लौटें तब तय होगा कौन साथ जाएगा
text_en: When the men of the house return from the fields, it will be decided who goes with her.
rationale: Accompaniment depends on family. The field work is the men's, not hers.

text_hi: देवर की शादी है, घरवालों ने अभी कहीं जाने से मना कर दिया
text_en: It is her brother-in-law's wedding; the family has refused any outings for now.

text_hi: पति कहते हैं डॉक्टर बेकार डराते हैं, जाने की ज़रूरत नहीं
text_en: Her husband says doctors scare people needlessly and there is no need to go.
rationale: Husband blocks attendance. The word about scaring is the husband's opinion; she expresses no fear.

text_hi: मायके वाले और ससुराल वाले दोनों की राय अलग है
text_en: Her parents' family and her in-laws have different opinions.
rationale: Family disagreement holds the decision. Context-dependent; review.

text_hi: ननद साथ चलने को तैयार नहीं
text_en: Her sister-in-law is not willing to go with her.
rationale: No family member willing to accompany.

text_hi: pati ne abhi mana kar diya hai
text_en: Her husband has refused for now.

text_hi: ghar wale permission nahi de rahe
text_en: The family is not giving permission.

text_hi: koi saath jaane wala nahi hai
text_en: There is no one to go with her.

text_hi: pati se poochh ke batayegi
text_en: She will tell after asking her husband.

text_hi: husband support nahi kar rahe, unko lagta hai waste of time
text_en: Her husband is not supportive; he thinks it is a waste of time.

text_hi: family ki permission pending hai
text_en: The family's permission is pending.

text_hi: बड़े अस्पताल के नाम से ही घबरा गई।
text_en: She got anxious at the very mention of the big hospital.

text_hi: उसे डर है कि वहां कोई बड़ी बीमारी न निकल आए।
text_en: She is afraid that some serious illness may be found there.
rationale: Fear of what will be found.

text_hi: पिछली बार जांच में दर्द हुआ था, दोबारा नहीं कराना चाहती
text_en: The examination hurt last time; she does not want it again.

text_hi: गांव में किसी को पता चल गया तो लोग बातें बनाएंगे
text_en: If anyone in the village finds out, people will gossip.

text_hi: मशीन और औज़ारों से डरती है
text_en: She is scared of the machines and instruments.

text_hi: पुरुष डॉक्टर से जांच कराने में शर्म आती है
text_en: She feels embarrassed to be examined by a male doctor.

text_hi: बोली ऑपरेशन नहीं कराऊंगी, चाहे कुछ हो
text_en: She said she will not have an operation, whatever happens.

text_hi: पड़ोस की एक महिला वहां गई थी और ठीक नहीं हुई, इसलिए भरोसा नहीं
text_en: A woman from the neighbourhood went there and did not get better, so she does not trust it.

text_hi: अभी हिम्मत नहीं जुटा पाई है।
text_en: She has not been able to gather the courage yet.

text_hi: रिपोर्ट देखकर बहुत रोने लगी, बोली अभी नहीं जाऊंगी
text_en: She started crying a lot after seeing the report and said she will not go now.

text_hi: सुई और खून निकालने से बहुत डर लगता है
text_en: She is very scared of needles and having blood drawn.

text_hi: सोचती है वहां भर्ती कर लेंगे और घर नहीं आने देंगे
text_en: She thinks they will admit her there and not let her come home.
rationale: Fear of being admitted. Could also be read as a misunderstanding; review.

text_hi: झाड़-फूंक करवा रही है, कहती है उसी से ठीक होगा
text_en: She is getting faith healing done and says that will make her well.
rationale: Preference for traditional healing over the referral; classified as hesitancy. Review.

text_hi: बेटी की शादी होनी है, बीमारी की बात फैल गई तो रिश्ता टूट सकता है
text_en: Her daughter is to be married; if word of an illness spreads the match could break.
rationale: Stigma concern. The wedding is the reason for the stigma, not a household restriction.

text_hi: usko bahut darr lag raha hai
text_en: She is very scared.

text_hi: sharam aati hai bolti hai
text_en: She says she feels embarrassed.

text_hi: abhi jaana nahi chahti, ghabrahat hai
text_en: She does not want to go now; she is anxious.

text_hi: log kya kahenge yahi soch rahi hai
text_en: She keeps thinking about what people will say.

text_hi: procedure se dari hui hai, bol rahi pain hoga
text_en: She is afraid of the procedure and says it will hurt.

text_hi: hospital pe trust nahi hai uska
text_en: She does not trust the hospital.

text_hi: रोज़ की दिहाड़ी पर काम करती है, एक दिन भी छुट्टी नहीं ले सकती
text_en: She works on daily wages and cannot take even one day off.

text_hi: धान कटाई चल रही है, खेत छोड़कर नहीं जा सकती
text_en: The paddy harvest is on; she cannot leave the fields.

text_hi: छोटा बच्चा अभी दूध पीता है, उसे किसके पास छोड़े
text_en: The small child is still breastfeeding; who would she leave him with.

text_hi: सास बिस्तर पर हैं, उनकी देखभाल वही करती है
text_en: Her mother-in-law is bedridden and she is the one who looks after her.
rationale: Caregiving duty. Mentions mother-in-law but no permission issue.

text_hi: ईंट भट्ठे पर काम है, ठेकेदार छुट्टी नहीं देता
text_en: She works at a brick kiln; the contractor does not give leave.

text_hi: मनरेगा का काम मिला है, नागा हुआ तो पैसे कटेंगे
text_en: She has MGNREGA work; if she misses a day her pay will be cut.
rationale: Lost wages from missing work. Lost wages are coded as work, not access_cost.

text_hi: घर में गाय-बकरी हैं, उनका चारा पानी कौन करेगा
text_en: There are cows and goats at home; who will feed and water them.

text_hi: तीन बच्चे स्कूल जाते हैं, सुबह-शाम सब उसी के ज़िम्मे
text_en: Three children go to school; everything morning and evening is her responsibility.

text_hi: तेंदूपत्ता तोड़ाई का सीज़न है, पूरा परिवार जंगल में
text_en: It is tendu-leaf picking season; the whole family is in the forest.
rationale: Seasonal livelihood work. The family mention is not a permission issue.

text_hi: दुकान अकेले संभालती है, बंद की तो नुकसान
text_en: She runs the shop alone; closing it means a loss.
rationale: Cannot leave own business. Loss is about work, not travel cost.

text_hi: काम से लौटते-लौटते अस्पताल का समय खत्म हो जाता है
text_en: By the time she gets back from work, the hospital's hours are over.
rationale: Work schedule conflicts with facility hours.

text_hi: बीमार ससुर की सेवा में लगी है
text_en: She is busy caring for her sick father-in-law.

text_hi: पोते-पोतियों को संभालना पड़ता है, बहू काम पर जाती है
text_en: She has to look after the grandchildren because her daughter-in-law goes to work.
rationale: Caregiving. The paid work mentioned belongs to the daughter-in-law.

text_hi: हफ्ते में सिर्फ रविवार खाली, उस दिन अस्पताल में डॉक्टर नहीं
text_en: Only Sunday is free in the week, and there is no doctor at the hospital that day.
rationale: Work schedule leaves no usable day.

text_hi: kaam pe chhutti nahi milti
text_en: She does not get leave from work.

text_hi: bachche chhote hain, unko chhod ke nahi ja sakti
text_en: The children are small; she cannot leave them.

text_hi: abhi khet ka kaam zyada hai
text_en: There is a lot of farm work right now.

text_hi: majdoori chhodegi to us din khana nahi banega
text_en: If she skips wage work there will be no food that day.
rationale: Loss of daily wage. Coded as work; poverty implied but no travel or care cost stated.

text_hi: private factory hai, job se leave nahi milegi
text_en: It is a private factory; she will not get leave from the job.

text_hi: ghar pe elderly mother-in-law ki full time care karti hai
text_en: She cares for her elderly mother-in-law full time at home.

text_hi: उसे समझ नहीं आया कि दोबारा अस्पताल क्यों जाना है।
text_en: She did not understand why she has to go to the hospital again.
rationale: Does not understand reason for referral.

text_hi: पर्ची पढ़ नहीं सकती, किस विभाग में जाना है पता नहीं
text_en: She cannot read the slip and does not know which department to go to.
rationale: Lacks information on where to go.

text_hi: कह रही है अब तो ठीक लग रहा है, फिर जाने का क्या फायदा
text_en: She says she feels fine now, so what is the use of going.
rationale: Does not see the need for follow-up.

text_hi: तारीख याद नहीं, कब बुलाया था भूल गई
text_en: She does not remember the date; she forgot when she was called.
rationale: Missing information about when to attend.

text_hi: सोचती है दवाई खा ली तो काम हो गया
text_en: She thinks that once she has taken the medicine, the job is done.
rationale: Misunderstands that further steps are needed.

text_hi: उसे लगा जांच यहीं हो गई, आगे कुछ नहीं करना
text_en: She thought the test was done here and nothing more needs to be done.

text_hi: जिस अस्पताल जाना है, वो जगह उसे नहीं पता
text_en: She does not know where the hospital she has to go to is.
rationale: Lacks information about the destination. Not knowing the location is information, not transport.

text_hi: डॉक्टर ने जो लिखा वो सब अंग्रेज़ी में है, किसी से पढ़वाया नहीं
text_en: What the doctor wrote is all in English; she has not had anyone read it to her.

text_hi: उसे लगा ये सिर्फ सलाह थी, ज़रूरी नहीं
text_en: She thought it was only advice and not necessary.

text_hi: वहां पहुंचकर क्या करना है, किससे मिलना है, कुछ नहीं पता
text_en: She has no idea what to do after reaching there or whom to meet.

text_hi: बोली जब तकलीफ़ होगी तब देख लेंगे
text_en: She said they will see when there is some trouble.
rationale: Low understanding of why follow-up is needed now. Could also be read as hesitancy; review.

text_hi: रिपोर्ट में क्या लिखा है उसे किसी ने समझाया नहीं
text_en: Nobody explained to her what is written in the report.

text_hi: उसे लगता है ये वही जांच है जो पिछले साल हो चुकी
text_en: She thinks this is the same test that was already done last year.

text_hi: अस्पताल वालों ने फोन पर कुछ कहा था, ठीक से सुन नहीं पाई
text_en: The hospital staff said something on the phone; she could not hear it properly.

text_hi: usko pata hi nahi kab jaana hai
text_en: She does not even know when to go.

text_hi: samajh nahi aaya doctor ne kya bola
text_en: She did not understand what the doctor said.

text_hi: bol rahi ab theek hai to zaroorat nahi
text_en: She says she is fine now so there is no need.
rationale: Does not see the need. The view is her own, unlike a husband's refusal.

text_hi: parchi kho gayi, kahan jaana tha yaad nahi
text_en: The slip is lost and she does not remember where she had to go.

text_hi: referral ka reason usko clear nahi hai
text_en: The reason for the referral is not clear to her.

text_hi: date confuse ho gayi, usne next week samjha tha
text_en: She got confused about the date; she thought it was next week.

text_hi: कुछ परेशानी है।
text_en: There is some problem.
rationale: Too vague to infer any barrier; ask the patient.

text_hi: मंगलवार को बेटे के साथ जाएगी।
text_en: She will go with her son on Tuesday.
rationale: A plan, not a barrier. Family mention without constraint.

text_hi: घर पर नहीं मिली, कल फिर आना है
text_en: She was not at home; have to come again tomorrow.
rationale: Worker's visit note; no barrier reported.

text_hi: बात हुई, जाने को तैयार है
text_en: Spoke with her; she is ready to go.

text_hi: पति खुद मोटरसाइकिल से ले जाएंगे
text_en: Her husband himself will take her by motorcycle.
rationale: Husband and transport are mentioned but as solutions, not barriers.

text_hi: बाद में बताएगी
text_en: She will tell later.

text_hi: अभी नहीं जा पाएगी, कारण नहीं बताया
text_en: She will not be able to go now; she did not give a reason.

text_hi: पैसों का इंतज़ाम हो गया है, अगले हफ्ते जाएगी
text_en: The money has been arranged; she will go next week.

text_hi: आशा दीदी साथ जाएंगी, कोई दिक्कत नहीं बताई
text_en: The ASHA didi will go with her; she mentioned no difficulty.

text_hi: फोन बंद आ रहा है
text_en: The phone is switched off.

text_hi: घर में थोड़ी बात है, बाद में बताएगी
text_en: There is a bit of a matter at home; she will tell later.
rationale: Vague hint about home, not specific enough to code a household constraint. Ask.

text_hi: डर नहीं है, बस तारीख तय करनी है
text_en: She is not scared; a date just needs to be fixed.

text_hi: अस्पताल वाली जांच हो गई, रिपोर्ट लेकर आई है
text_en: The hospital test is done; she has brought the report.

text_hi: kal jaayegi bol rahi
text_en: She says she will go tomorrow.

text_hi: bas thoda problem hai
text_en: There is just a bit of a problem.

text_hi: ghar pe koi nahi tha
text_en: There was nobody at home.
rationale: Visit note; the phrase resembles no-accompaniment notes but describes the visit.

text_hi: patient ready hai, Monday ko jayegi
text_en: The patient is ready; she will go on Monday.

text_hi: follow up call kiya, no response
text_en: Made a follow-up call; no response.

text_hi: OPD card बन गया है, कल जाएगी
text_en: The OPD card has been made; she will go tomorrow.

text_hi: call किया, बोली सोचकर बताएगी
text_en: Called her; she said she will think and let us know.
rationale: Neutral deferral; no stated barrier. Compare with explicit hesitancy rows.

text_hi: transport arrange हो गया है, family भी साथ है
text_en: Transport has been arranged and the family is with her too.
rationale: Transport and family mentioned as resolved.

text_hi: visit पर मिली, कोई issue नहीं बताया
text_en: Met her during the visit; she mentioned no issue.

text_hi: किराया भी नहीं है और पति भी मना कर रहे हैं
text_en: There is no money for the fare, and her husband is also refusing.

text_hi: पैसा पति के हाथ में रहता है, वो देंगे तभी जा पाएगी
text_en: The money stays in her husband's hands; she can only go if he gives it.
rationale: Money access controlled by husband: both cost and household.

text_hi: अस्पताल दूर है और साथ जाने को कोई खाली नहीं
text_en: The hospital is far and nobody is free to go with her.

text_hi: एक दिन की मज़दूरी जाएगी, ऊपर से बस का खर्च अलग
text_en: She will lose a day's wages, and the bus cost on top of that.

text_hi: खेत में काम है और शहर तक जाने का साधन भी नहीं
text_en: There is work in the fields, and no transport to town either.

text_hi: डर भी है और समझ भी नहीं आया कि जाना क्यों ज़रूरी है
text_en: She is scared and also did not understand why it is necessary to go.
rationale: Fear plus not understanding the need.

text_hi: बच्चों को छोड़कर जाना है और सास साथ देने को तैयार नहीं
text_en: She would have to leave the children, and her mother-in-law is not willing to help.
rationale: Childcare plus lack of family support.

text_hi: पति कहते हैं इलाज में बहुत पैसा लगेगा, रहने दो
text_en: Her husband says the treatment will cost a lot, so leave it.

text_hi: गांव की औरतें कह रही थीं वहां जाकर बीमारी बढ़ जाती है, इसलिए डर गई
text_en: Women in the village were saying that going there makes the illness worse, so she got scared.

text_hi: सुपरवाइज़र बोला फिर गैरहाज़िर हुई तो काम से निकाल देंगे, इसी का डर है
text_en: The supervisor said that if she is absent again she will be dismissed; that is what she fears.
rationale: Work barrier. The fear is about losing the job, not about care, so fear_hesitancy is 0.

text_hi: पर्ची गुम हो गई और दोबारा आने-जाने का पैसा नहीं
text_en: The slip got lost, and there is no money to make the trip again.
rationale: Lost referral information plus travel cost.

text_hi: पति बाहर मजदूरी पर हैं, उनके बिना नहीं जाएगी, और बच्चे भी छोटे हैं
text_en: Her husband is away doing labour; she will not go without him, and the children are small too.
rationale: Needs husband to accompany her; childcare. The labour is the husband's.

text_hi: ऑपरेशन के नाम से डरती है, घरवाले भी कहते हैं मत कराओ
text_en: She is scared at the mention of an operation, and the family also says not to have it.

text_hi: बोली पैसे होते तो चली जाती, पर डर भी लगता है
text_en: She said she would have gone if she had money, but she also feels scared.

text_hi: रोज़ खेत जाना होता है, और उसे लगता है अब ज़रूरत भी नहीं
text_en: She has to go to the fields every day, and she feels there is no need anymore.
rationale: Farm work plus not seeing the need.

text_hi: रास्ता लंबा है, अकेले जाने में डर लगता है, पति काम पर रहते हैं
text_en: The journey is long, she is afraid to go alone, and her husband is at work.
rationale: Distance plus no one to accompany her. Fear of travelling alone is coded as accompaniment, not care-related fear. Review.

text_hi: सास की देखभाल और घर का सारा काम उसी पर, पति कहते हैं बाद में देखेंगे
text_en: Caring for her mother-in-law and all the housework fall on her; her husband says they will see later.

text_hi: जांच का खर्च सुना तो डर गई, कहा पहले घर में पूछूंगी
text_en: She got worried on hearing the cost of the tests and said she will ask at home first.
rationale: Cost worry plus household decision. The worry is about money, not care, so fear_hesitancy is 0.

text_hi: शहर कभी गई नहीं, रास्ता नहीं पता, और गाड़ी का किराया भी ज़्यादा
text_en: She has never been to town, does not know the way, and the vehicle fare is also high.
rationale: Lacks route information plus travel cost.

text_hi: मंडी में सब्ज़ी बेचती है, और उसे लगा रिपोर्ट नॉर्मल है
text_en: She sells vegetables at the market, and she thought the report was normal.
rationale: Own work plus misunderstanding of the report. No clinical claim about the report itself.

text_hi: पति की इजाज़त नहीं, और खुद भी लोकलाज से हिचक रही है
text_en: There is no permission from her husband, and she herself is hesitating out of social shame.

text_hi: धान रोपाई का समय है, पैसे भी नहीं, और घर से भी कोई साथ नहीं
text_en: It is paddy-transplanting time, there is no money either, and no one from home to go with her.
rationale: Three barriers: farm work, money, accompaniment.

text_hi: सोचती है वहां बहुत खर्चा होगा, किसी ने खर्च के बारे में ठीक से बताया नहीं
text_en: She thinks it will cost a lot there; nobody explained the costs to her properly.
rationale: Perceived cost plus an information gap about costs.

text_hi: paise bhi nahi aur pati bhi nahi maan rahe
text_en: There is no money, and her husband is not agreeing either.

text_hi: darr lagta hai aur ghar wale bhi saath nahi de rahe
text_en: She is scared, and the family is not supporting her either.
rationale: Fear plus lack of family support.

text_hi: kaam chhod ke jaaye to dihadi katti hai, bus ka kiraya alag
text_en: If she leaves work her daily wage is cut, and the bus fare is extra.

text_hi: bachcha ghar pe bimar hai, aur use samajh nahi aaya kab jaana hai
text_en: Her child is ill at home, and she did not understand when to go.

text_hi: hospital door hai, aur sharam bhi aati hai
text_en: The hospital is far, and she also feels embarrassed.

text_hi: financial issue hai plus husband ka support nahi
text_en: There is a financial issue plus no support from her husband.

text_hi: scared hai, aur kyon jaana hai ye bhi nahi samjhi
text_en: She is scared, and she also did not understand why she has to go.

text_hi: harvest season hai, plus koi accompany karne wala nahi
text_en: It is harvest season, plus there is no one to accompany her.

text_hi: travel ka kharcha zyada hai, aur usko lagta hai ab zarurat nahi
text_en: The travel expense is high, and she thinks there is no need now.
rationale: Travel cost plus not seeing the need.

text_hi: transport नहीं है और daily wage भी जाएगी
text_en: There is no transport and the daily wage will also be lost.

text_hi: husband मना कर रहे, और उसे procedure से fear है
text_en: Her husband is refusing, and she is afraid of the procedure.

text_hi: report का मतलब समझ नहीं आया, और बच्चे को छोड़ नहीं सकती
text_en: She did not understand what the report means, and she cannot leave the child.

text_hi: family शादी में busy है, और बस का fare भी नहीं
text_en: The family is busy with a wedding, and there is no bus fare either.
